summary: The privacy-dashboard has strong export workflow feedback but critical issues: 'Delete sample data' is out of view in mobile, privacy checkup 'Next' button fails, and many controls remain untested (e.g., account menu, app access). Mobile tap targets are small, and the privacy checkup workflow is blocked by interaction failures.

issues.problem: 'Delete sample data' button is consistently out of view in mobile, blocking interaction.
issues.evidence: Multiple click attempts failed due to element outside viewport (e.g., step 79: 'element is outside of the viewport'). Scrolling attempts also failed to bring it into view.
issues.suggested_fix: Adjust layout to keep 'Delete sample data' in mobile view (e.g., sticky footer, reposition) or ensure scroll targets it.

issues.problem: Privacy checkup 'Next' button (ux-74) fails to respond, blocking workflow progression.
issues.evidence: Over 10 click attempts timed out (e.g., 'Locator.click: Timeout 4000ms exceeded') with no workflow advancement.
issues.suggested_fix: Fix button interactivity (e.g., z-index, event binding) and test workflow progression.

issues.problem: Mobile tap targets (e.g., 'Open navigation', 'Account menu') are below 44px guidance.
issues.evidence: Layout warnings: 'Tap target is 38x38px, below the 44px mobile guidance' for multiple buttons.
issues.suggested_fix: Enlarge tap targets to 44x44px (e.g., padding, reposition) for mobile interactions.

issues.problem: Export dropdown changes (e.g., file type, size) lack immediate visual feedback on configuration impact (e.g., estimated size).
issues.evidence: After changing 'File type' to .tgz or 'Archive size' to 4GB, no visible update to estimated size/text (e.g., step 73: 'No visible changes to the export configuration').
issues.suggested_fix: Update estimated size/configuration text dynamically when dropdowns change.

issues.problem: Major controls (e.g., 'Account menu', 'App access', 'Devices') remain untested (20% feature coverage).
issues.evidence: Coverage gaps list 30+ untested interactables (e.g., 'Apps', 'Data controls', 'Devices').
issues.suggested_fix: Test unexercised controls (e.g., 'App access', 'Devices & locations') to identify gaps.

issues.problem: Small tap targets (e.g., 'Open navigation' 38x38px) violate mobile accessibility guidelines.
issues.evidence: Layout warnings: 'Tap target is 38x38px, below the 44px mobile guidance' for multiple buttons.
issues.suggested_fix: Increase tap target size to 44x44px via padding or repositioning.

issues.problem: Privacy checkup workflow is blocked by unresponsive 'Next' button, preventing users from addressing recommendations.
issues.evidence: Over 10 click attempts timed out (e.g., 'Locator.click: Timeout 4000ms exceeded') with no workflow advancement.
issues.suggested_fix: Fix button interactivity (e.g., event binding, z-index) and test workflow steps.

issues.problem: Export 'Frequency' dropdown change (e.g., 'Every 2 months') lacks visible feedback on configuration.
issues.evidence: After selecting 'Every 2 months for 1 year', no visible text update to estimated size/description (e.g., step 77: 'No visible text or URL changes').
issues.suggested_fix: Update estimated size/configuration text to reflect frequency (e.g., '4 GB - Every 2 months for 1 year').
